text:
maria: Quick smoke — brought up alouette-compact (4096 dim, per-channel int6) in staging, recall@10 on wiki-holdout dropped from 0.82 -> 0.69. Anyone else see this?

Eugene: Can you paste the eval cmd and the dataset split?

maria: Ran `./eval_embeddings --model alouette-compact --quant int6 --batch 64 --holdout wiki_h1000`

maria: Output snippet:
```
Recall@10: 0.69
Avg cosine (pos): 0.71
Avg cosine (neg): 0.42
Silhouette: 0.09
```

kai: Oof silhouette 0.09 is low. Did you use the same normalization / whitening pipeline as baseline? int6 per-channel can skew scale.

maria: Yup used our standard pipeline `norm->pca(256)->whiten`.

natalie: @maria can you dump nearest-neigh examples for a few queries? Want to see qualitative.

maria: Pasted 3 examples + gt in staging gist: <https://redwood.internal/gist/abc123>

bench-bot: Automated rerun finished (seed=42): recall@10=0.70, recall@1=0.38, silhouette=0.10 :robot_face:

kai: Slight improvement but still regressed vs baseline. Two hypotheses:
- quantization bias (int6) changing relative distances
- PCA dim reduction (256) interacting differently with quant noise

Eugene: Quick ablation request: run int8-perchannel and float16 baseline on same split, and also int6 with pca=512.

maria: Kicking off those runs now. ETA ~30m. Will post plots and NN samples when done.

natalie: Also add SNR (signal to noise) by dim before/after quant — helps diagnose energy collapse.

maria: Added to job. thanks :thumbsup:
